name: JW Marriott Resort Kaafu Atoll Island
insider_take: This isn't just another overwater paradise – it's the Maldives' first JW Marriott resort, where luxury meets the raw beauty of a pristine uninhabited island in the Shaviyani Atoll.
whats_special: The resort sits on Vagaru Island, accessible only by a scenic 55-minute seaplane journey that offers breathtaking aerial views of the countless atolls below. What makes this property truly unique is its house reef – one of the Maldives' most pristine coral gardens teeming with manta rays, whale sharks, and over 1,000 species of fish, all accessible directly from the beach.
pro_tip: Book your stay during manta ray season (May-November) and request an overwater villa on the sunset side – you'll have front-row seats to both marine life and the Maldives' legendary golden hour.
dont_miss: The resort's signature underwater dining experience at their overwater restaurant, and the complimentary snorkeling excursions to nearby Hanifaru Bay – a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve famous for its manta ray feeding grounds. The spa treatments using traditional Maldivian healing techniques are equally unforgettable.
pros: Luxurious overwater and beachfront villas with private pools
Multiple dining venues featuring international cuisine
Pristine private island location with crystal-clear waters
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane transfer
